description: ROM Ali 8-Direction D-Pad Velocity Resolver & Slide Motion Recognizer (0x86B4)

routines.name: ali_dpad_8way_velocity_resolver
routines.purpose: Decodes 16-entry jump table 0x0085FA to calculate 8-way directional velocities (Up/Down 0x30000, Left/Right 0x36000, Diagonals 0x2A000/0x25800) and facing

routines.name: ali_motion_slide_recognizer_0x86b4
routines.purpose: Official Slide motion recognizer: scans up to 30 frames in $FF1668 for 4-step rotational sequence using LUT 0x008768; clears ring count on match
